events.title: Jimi Hendrix remembered
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of rock legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Tribute to a legend
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix today, an artist who redefined the electric guitar and left an indelible mark on music. What's your favourite track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released on September 26, 1969, in the UK, and October 1, 1969, in the US.

angles.name: Iconic album anniversary
angles.copy: It's 57 years since The Beatles dropped the legendary 'Abbey Road'. What's your go-to track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, and turns 75 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to Chrissie Hynde, turning 75 today! What's your favourite Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on September 21, 1972, and celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 8, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine album anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine', an album that continues to inspire. Which track resonates most with you?

events.title: 25 years of the iPod
events.blurb: The first-generation Apple iPod was introduced on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod's 25th birthday
angles.copy: Can you believe it's 25 years since the original iPod dropped? Remember loading up your playlists for hours? What was on your first iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940, and would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939, and turns 87 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece – what are your essential tracks from it?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today, 35 years since we lost a true rock legend. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul anniversary
angles.copy: Happy 61st anniversary to The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul'! An album that marked a significant shift in their sound. What's your favourite from it?

events.title: John Lennon remembered
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of John Lennon, who was tragically killed in 1980 at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, a visionary artist whose impact on music and peace continues to resonate globally.
